source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 7 (PDF 175-193), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 7 (Legal and Ethical Aspects of Computing System) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define Terms of Use. Who sets them?
(Terms of Use ki definition likhein. Inhein kaun tay karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Terms of Use (Terms and Conditions ya Terms of Service) qanooni muahide hain jo batate hain ke service ya product kaise istemal ho. Inhein provider (website, app ya software company) banata hai aur user ko maanna hota hai.

book_ref.quote: are legal agreements that outline how a service or product can be used

blocks.prompt:
2 What do Google's Terms of Use explain when you sign up for Gmail?
(Gmail par account banate waqt Google ki Terms of Use kya batati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh batati hain ke email account kaise istemal karna hai, kaun sa content share karna mana hai, aur Google aap ka shakhsi data kaise sambhalta hai.

book_ref.quote: These terms explain how you can use your email account, the types of content you are prohibited from sharing

blocks.prompt:
3 Name the legal challenges and the ethical considerations in computing mentioned in the introduction.
(Introduction mein computing ke qanooni challenges aur akhlaqi pehlu likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Qanooni challenges: data protection, intellectual property rights, qawaneen ki pabandi.
Akhlaqi pehlu: privacy, insaaf aur muashre par technology ke asraat.

book_ref.quote: Ethical considerations address privacy, fairness, and the broader societal impacts of technology

blocks.prompt:
4 How do Terms of Use protect the rights of a user of a food delivery service? Give the book's example.
(Food delivery service ke user ke haqooq ki Terms of Use kaise hifazat karti hain? Kitab ki misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Terms user ke haq batati hain: privacy, service ka miyar aur ghalat hone par shikayat ka haq. Foodpanda ki terms batati hain ke ghalat order ya delivery mein der par kya hoga.

book_ref.quote: When we use a food delivery service in Pakistan like Foodpanda

blocks.prompt:
5 How do Terms of Use act as a legal safeguard for businesses?
(Terms of Use karobar ke liye qanooni hifazat kaise karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh had bandi kar ke company ko un qanooni masail se bachati hain jo users ke qawaid na maanne se hote hain. Misal: online education platform bina ijazat course content share karna mana karta hai.

book_ref.quote: They set boundaries to protect the company from potential legal issues caused by users not adhering to the rules

blocks.prompt:
6 What are user obligations clauses? Give an example.
(User obligations clauses kya hain? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: User obligations batati hain ke user se kya tawaqqu hai. Misal: Careem valid phone number maangta hai aur ghair-transport istemal mana karta hai.

book_ref.quote: These clauses outline what is expected from the user

blocks.prompt:
7 Give an example of a limitation of liability clause.
(Limitation of liability clause ki misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Agar online banking app kuch der band ho to bank ki terms aisi rukawat par us ki zimmedari mehdood kar deti hain.

book_ref.quote: if you use an online banking service and the app is temporarily down

blocks.prompt:
8 What is a termination of service clause? Give an example.
(Termination of service clause kya hai? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh batati hai ke kin halaat mein provider user ki access khatam kar sakta hai. Misal: Facebook nafrat angez ya ghalat maloomat phailane wale accounts band kar sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: This clause explains the conditions under which the provider can terminate a user's access to the service

blocks.prompt:
9 What do intellectual property rights clauses protect? Give an example.
(Intellectual property rights clauses kis cheez ki hifazat karti hain? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh provider ki milkiyati cheezon (logos, software, waghera) ki hifazat karti hain. Misal: news website apne articles bina ijazat copy karna mana karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Pakistani news website may include terms that prohibit users from copying and distributing their articles without permission

blocks.prompt:
10 What are the legal ramifications of violating Terms of Use? Give one example.
(Terms of Use todne ke qanooni nataij kya hain? Aik misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Jurmana, muqadma ya service se pabandi. Misal: bina license software istemal par software piracy ki qanooni karrawai.

book_ref.quote: Companies that uses unlicensed software face legal risks and cybersecurity threats

blocks.prompt:
11 What should an online course's terms clearly specify, according to the ethical considerations?
(Akhlaqi pehlu ke mutabiq online course ki terms mein kya wazeh hona chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Terms mein wazeh ho ke certificate milega ya nahi, shakhsi data kaise sambhala jayega aur koi izafi fees hai ya nahi; chhupe kharchon ke saath course ko muft na bataya jaye.

book_ref.quote: It is essential for companies to ensure that their terms are clear, straightforward, and not overly complex or deceptive

blocks.prompt:
12 Name the three personal rights within Terms of Use.
(Terms of Use mein teen shakhsi haqooq likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Privacy ka haq
2. Maloomat (informed hone) ka haq
3. Razamandi wapas lene (withdraw consent) ka haq

book_ref.quote: It is essential for users to be aware of their rights and understand how to exercise them

blocks.prompt:
13 What rights does a user of a local e-commerce website have about his personal information?
(Local e-commerce website ke user ke paas apni shakhsi maloomat ke bare mein kya haqooq hain?)
blocks.explanation: User jaan sakta hai ke address aur phone number kaise istemal honge, data dekh aur durust ya delete karwa sakta hai, aur platform chhorne par account aur data mitwa sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: users have the right to know how their personal information, such as addresses and phone numbers, will be utilized

blocks.prompt:
14 What are privacy and security threats? Why should we understand them?
(Privacy aur security threats kya hain? Inhein samajhna kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh khatre shakhsi maloomat, maali data aur online security ko nuqsan pohancha sakte hain. Inhein samajhna khatron se bachao aur hassas maloomat ki hifazat ke liye zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: A comprehensive understanding of these threats is essential for safeguarding against potential risks

blocks.prompt:
15 Name the five primary categories of security threats of online services.
(Online services ke security threats ki paanch bunyadi qismein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Spam
2. Spyware
3. Cookies
4. Phishing
5. Pharming

book_ref.quote: There are five primary categories of security threats of using online services

blocks.prompt:
16 What is spam? Give an example.
(Spam kya hai? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Spam email ya phone par aane wale na-pasandeeda messages hain. Misal: na-maloom numbers se jaali inaam ya saste qarze ki offers.

book_ref.quote: Spam refers to unwanted messages that you receive on your email or phone

blocks.prompt:
17 How can spyware get onto a device and what can it do?
(Spyware device par kaise aata hai aur kya karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ghair mo'tabar jagah se free app download karne par spyware install ho sakta hai. Yeh chupke se aap ki websites aur daali gayi maloomat dekhta hai.

book_ref.quote: This spyware can secretly monitor your online activities, such as the websites you visit

blocks.prompt:
18 What are cookies?
(Cookies kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cookies chhoti files hain jo websites aap ke device par rakhti hain; yeh login details aur pasand yaad rakhti hain.

book_ref.quote: Cookies are small files that websites place on your device when you visit them

blocks.prompt:
19 What is phishing? Give an example.
(Phishing kya hai? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Phishing aisa dhoka hai jis mein koi mo'tabar idara ban kar shakhsi maloomat hasil karta hai. Misal: bank jaisi email link par click kar ke account details maangti hai.

book_ref.quote: If you follow these instructions, your money could be at risk because the email is a fake

blocks.prompt:
20 What is pharming? Give an example.
(Pharming kya hai? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Pharming mein user be-khabri mein jaali website par pohancha diya jata hai. Misal: bank ki site kholte hue jaali hu-ba-hu site khulti hai aur login details scammer le leta hai.

book_ref.quote: you are sent to a counterfeit site that looks just like your bank's real site

blocks.prompt:
21 Differentiate between spam and spyware.
(Spam aur spyware mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq table mein diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: Spam emails may have odd offers or suspicious links that make them stand out

rows: Email ya phone par na-pasandeeda messages
Nuqsan deh software jo chupke se aap ki harkaat dekhta hai
Aasani se pehchana jata hai: bari tadaad aur ishtihar
Background mein khamoshi se chalta hai, nazar nahi aata
Maqsad: products bechna ya dhoke se khareedari
Maqsad: chupke se shakhsi maloomat jama karna
Aksar sirf pareshani
Data chura kar privacy ke bare masail

blocks.prompt:
22 Write the consequences of spam, spyware and cookies.
(Spam, spyware aur cookies ke nataij likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Spam: aksar sirf pareshani.
Spyware: shakhsi data chura kar privacy ke bare masail.
Cookies: online activity track kar ke privacy mein dakhal.

book_ref.quote: The impact of these threats varies, but all can affect your safety and privacy

blocks.prompt:
23 Name the five security threat prevention techniques discussed in the chapter.
(Chapter mein di gayi security threats se bachao ki paanch techniques likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Spam filters
2. Antivirus software
3. Cookie management
4. Phishing pehchanna
5. Pharming se bachao

book_ref.quote: These techniques help safeguard your personal information and ensure a safer online experience

blocks.prompt:
24 What is the use of a spam filter?
(Spam filter ka kya faida hai?)
blocks.explanation: Spam filter na-pasandeeda emails ko inbox se door rakhta hai; inhein khud alag folder mein daal deta ya delete kar deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Spam filters help keep unwanted emails out of your inbox

blocks.prompt:
25 How does antivirus software protect a computer when a file is downloaded?
(File download karte waqt antivirus computer ki hifazat kaise karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Antivirus spyware jaise programs se bachata hai. Download file mein chhupe khatre check karta hai; mehfooz ho to khul jati hai, nuqsan deh ho to khabardar kar ke nuqsan se rokta hai.

book_ref.quote: Antivirus software protects your computer from harmful programs like spyware

blocks.prompt:
26 What is cookie management? Give an example.
(Cookie management kya hai? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Cookie management yani faisla karna ke kaun si cookies rakhni aur kaun si mitani hain. Misal: pasandeeda shopping site ki cookies rakhein, baqi sites ki mita dein.

book_ref.quote: You can keep cookies from your favorite shopping website so you don't have to log in every time

blocks.prompt:
27 How can you guard against pharming?
(Pharming se kaise bacha ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hamesha dekhein ke website ka address durust aur mehfooz hai: address bar mein https:// aur taala (padlock) ka nishan ho.

book_ref.quote: To guard against pharming, always check that the website's address is correct and secure

blocks.text: 7.3 The Digital Divide and Its Impacts

blocks.prompt:
28 What is the digital divide? Why is it a critical issue?
(Digital divide kya hai? Yeh ahem masla kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Digital divide ICT tak rasai rakhne aur na rakhne walon ke darmiyan khala hai (internet, devices, digital literacy). Yeh taleem, rozgar, sehat aur samaji shirkat mein na-barabar mauqe paida karta hai.

book_ref.quote: This divide can manifest in various ways, including disparities in access to the internet, computing devices, and digital literacy

blocks.prompt:
29 Name the four causes (barriers) of the digital divide.
(Digital divide ki chaar wajoohat (barriers) likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Economic (maali) barriers
2. Geographical (jughrafiyai) barriers
3. Educational (taleemi) barriers
4. Social (samaji) barriers

book_ref.quote: Several factors contribute to the digital divide:

blocks.prompt:
30 Explain the economic barrier to digital access.
(Digital rasai ki maali rukawat (economic barrier) samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Bohat se log computer, smartphone ya broadband ka kharcha nahi utha sakte; yeh khaas taur par taraqqi pazeer mumalik, dehi ilaqon aur kam aamdani walon mein hai.

book_ref.quote: This economic disparity is particularly evident in developing countries, rural areas, and among low-income populations

blocks.prompt:
31 Differentiate between social barriers and educational barriers to digital access.
(Digital rasai ki social aur educational barriers mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq table mein diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: women in some regions may face cultural barriers that limit their access to ICT

rows: Umar, jins aur maazoori ki wajah se
Digital literacy ki kami ki wajah se
Misal: buzurg nayi technology kam istemal karte hain; kuch ilaqon mein auraton par saqafati pabandi
Log maujood technology chalana nahi jaante
Technology qareeb ho tab bhi rasai mehdood
Theek taleem aur training na hone se

blocks.prompt:
32 How did the digital divide affect education during the COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan?
(COVID-19 ke dauran Pakistan mein digital divide ne taleem ko kaise mutasir kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Jab schools online ho gaye to gharib ya dehi students internet ya device na hone se peeche reh gaye, aur taleemi khala barh gaya.

book_ref.quote: Students who lack access to these resources are at a significant disadvantage

blocks.prompt:
33 How does the digital divide create economic disparities?
(Digital divide maali na-barabari kaise paida karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Naukriyon ke liye digital skills chahiye, is liye internet se mehroom log rozgar nahi pate. Pakistan mein online job portals aur digital banking zyada tar shehron tak hain, is liye shehri aur dehi farq barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: access to online job portals and digital banking services is often limited to those in urban areas

blocks.prompt:
34 What are health disparities caused by the digital divide? Give an example.
(Digital divide se paida hone wali health disparities kya hain? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Digital sehat ki maloomat, telemedicine aur appointment tak rasai na hone se sehat kharab ho sakti hai. Misal: dehi ilaqe telemedicine se mehroom, tashkhees aur ilaaj mein der.

book_ref.quote: individuals may experience poorer health outcomes due to a lack of timely information and medical care

blocks.prompt:
35 What is the digital literacy gap?
(Digital literacy gap kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Technology se mehroom log zaroori digital skills nahi seekhte, is liye technology jaanne aur na jaanne walon ka farq barhta hai; woh naukri ki darkhwast ya sarkari services online nahi le pate.

book_ref.quote: This gap can affect their ability to navigate digital environments effectively and make use of online resources

blocks.prompt:
36 Name three ways of bridging the digital divide.
(Digital divide khatam karne ke teen tareeqe likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Hukoomati iqdamat: jahan internet nahi wahan dhancha banana (jaise USF).
2. Taleemi programs: schools aur community centres technology sikhayein.
3. Public-private partnerships: technology sasti karna.

book_ref.quote: Schools and community centers can teach people how to use technology

blocks.prompt:
37 What is meant by safe and responsible information utilization?
(Maloomat ke mehfooz aur zimmedarana istemal se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ka matlab hai maloomat ko ehtiyat aur zimmedari se istemal karna: source samajhna, us ki mo'tabariyat dekhna aur zimmedari se istemal karna.

book_ref.quote: with a focus on understanding sources, identifying reliability, and ensuring that we use information responsibly

blocks.prompt:
38 What is source evaluation? Give an example of a reliable source.
(Source evaluation kya hai? Qabil-e-aitmaad source ki misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Source evaluation yani dekhna ke maloomat kahan se aayi. Misal: sarkari websites aur mustanad khabron ke idare, kyun ke woh durusti ke sakht usool par chalte hain.

book_ref.quote: When we talk about source evaluation, we mean checking where the information comes from

blocks.prompt:
39 What is meant by assessing credibility? Give the book's example.
(Assessing credibility se kya muraad hai? Kitab ki misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Is ka matlab hai dekhna ke maloomat kisi mahir ya ikhtiyar wale se aayi hai. Misal: Eid ke chaand ki khabar sarkari Hilal Committee se, social media se nahi.

book_ref.quote: Assessing credibility means figuring out if the information is coming from an expert or someone with authority on the topic

blocks.prompt:
40 Differentiate between a primary source and a secondary source.
(Primary source aur secondary source mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq table mein diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: A research paper written by scientists who conducted the study is a primary source

rows: Asal mawad jis mein tabdeeli nahi hui
Kisi aur ke asal kaam par mabni mawad
Misal: study karne wale scientists ka research paper
Misal: usi research ka kisi aur ka likha khulasa

blocks.prompt:
41 What are critical thinking skills? Give an example.
(Critical thinking skills kya hain? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Critical thinking maloomat ko parakhne ki salahiyat hai: sawal karna, mukhtalif nazariyat dekhna aur soch samajh kar faisla. Misal: nayi technology par raye se pehle mukhtalif sources dekhna.

book_ref.quote: Critical thinking skills are necessary for analyzing and evaluating information

blocks.prompt:
42 What are red flags? Name three.
(Red flags kya hain? Teen ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Red flags woh nishaniyan hain jo batati hain ke source shayad ghair mo'tabar hai:
1. Musannif ki maloomat na hona
2. Sansani khez headlines
3. Hawala (references) na dena

book_ref.quote: Red flags are signs that indicate a source might be unreliable

blocks.prompt:
43 How can you avoid being misled by information online?
(Online maloomat se dhoka khane se kaise bacha ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Maloomat ka asal source tasdeeq karein, musannif ki qabliyat dekhein, janibdari ya sansani khezi par nazar rakhein, aur mukhtalif nazariyat dekhein.

book_ref.quote: Always verify the origin, check for author credentials, and be on the lookout for signs of bias or sensationalism

blocks.text: 7.5 Computing's Impact on Individuals and Society

blocks.prompt:
44 Name three technologies whose widespread adoption has changed society.
(Teen technologies ke naam likhein jin ke aam hone se muashra badal gaya.)
blocks.explanation: Internet, smartphones aur artificial intelligence (AI). In se zindagi, kaam aur rabte ka andaz badal gaya, musbat aur manfi dono asraat ke saath.

book_ref.quote: Computing systems have revolutionized the way we live, work, and communicate, bringing profound changes to society

blocks.prompt:
45 Give two positive impacts of computing with examples (other than communication).
(Computing ke do musbat asraat misalon ke saath likhein (communication ke ilawa).)
blocks.explanation:
1. Maloomat aur taleem tak rasai: Coursera aur edX se door ilaqon ke students bari universities ke courses le sakte hain.
2. Maeeshat ki taraqqi: Daraz jaise e-commerce se chhote karobar mulk bhar tak pohanchte hain.

book_ref.quote: The internet has made it possible for people to access vast amounts of information on nearly any topic

blocks.prompt:
46 Write three negative impacts of computing on society.
(Muashre par computing ke teen manfi asraat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Digital divide: dehi ilaqon mein internet aur devices ki kami.
2. Ghalat maloomat aur fake news, jo samaji bechaini laati hain (jaise COVID-19 vaccine afwahein).
3. Privacy: data ka ghalat istemal (jaise NADRA data leak).

book_ref.quote: Another negative impact is the spread of misinformation and fake news, which can lead to social unrest

blocks.prompt:
47 Define digital citizenship. What are its benefits?
(Digital citizenship ki definition likhein. Is ke faide kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Digital citizenship digital technology aur internet ko zimmedari aur akhlaq se istemal karna hai. Is se apni aur doosron ki hifazat, doosron ke haqooq ka ehteraam aur mehfooz digital mahol banta hai.

book_ref.quote: By practicing good digital citizenship, individuals can protect themselves and others from harm

blocks.prompt:
48 What is responsible digital behaviour? Give two of its practices.
(Responsible digital behaviour kya hai? Is ki do practices likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Technology aur internet ko izzat aur hifazat se istemal karna:
1. Mazboot password: 'password123' ke bajaye haroof, numbers aur symbols.
2. Phishing se bachna: mashkook links par click na karna.

book_ref.quote: Responsible digital behavior means using technology and the internet in ways that are respectful and safe

blocks.prompt:
49 Differentiate between respecting copyright and avoiding plagiarism.
(Copyright ka ehteraam aur plagiarism se bachne mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq table mein diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: Do not copy or use someone else's work without permission

rows: Kisi ka kaam bina ijazat copy ya istemal na karein
Khayalat aur maloomat asal musannif ke naam se dein
Misal: research paper mein online article ka text bina hawale copy na karein
Misal: assignment mein har quote ya khayal ka source likhein

blocks.prompt:
50 What is cybersecurity awareness? Where can a cyber crime be reported in Pakistan?
(Cybersecurity awareness kya hai? Pakistan mein cyber crime ki report kahan hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cybersecurity awareness online khatron se bachne ke tareeqe samajhna aur apnana hai. Pakistan mein cyber crime NR3C-FIA ko report hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Cybersecurity awareness involves understanding and implementing practices to protect oneself from online threats

blocks.prompt:
51 Give two ways to protect personal information online.
(Online shakhsi maloomat ki hifazat ke do tareeqe likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Privacy settings: tay karein kaun dekhe, jaise Facebook profile private.
2. Public maloomat mein ehtiyat: ghar ka pata ya phone number online na daalein.

book_ref.quote: Avoid sharing personal details in public forums or on social media

blocks.prompt:
52 What is collaborative problem solving? Name its two parts discussed in the chapter.
(Collaborative problem solving kya hai? Chapter mein is ke do hisse likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Mil kar challenges hal karna aur mushtarka maqsad hasil karna. Hisse: human-machine collaboration, aur teamwork aur knowledge sharing.

book_ref.quote: Collaborative problem solving involves working together with others to address challenges and achieve common goals

blocks.prompt:
53 What is meant by 'using tools' in human-machine collaboration? Give an example.
(Human-machine collaboration mein 'using tools' se kya muraad hai? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Kaam mein madad ke liye software aur digital tools istemal karna. Misal: group project ke data ke liye spreadsheet software.

book_ref.quote: Leverage software and digital tools to assist in tasks

blocks.prompt:
54 What is teamwork and knowledge sharing? Give an example.
(Teamwork aur knowledge sharing kya hai? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Doosron ke saath mil kar kaam aur maloomat ka tabadla. Misal: science group project mein students apni research share karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Work together on assignments or projects, each contributing your expertise

blocks.prompt:
55 What is accessible digital content? Name two ways of designing for accessibility.
(Accessible digital content kya hai? Accessibility ke liye design ke do tareeqe likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Aisa digital mawad jo har koi, maazoor afraad samet, istemal kar sake. Tareeqe: parhne mein aasaan fonts (Arial, Times New Roman) aur tasveeron ka alternative text.

book_ref.quote: Creating accessible digital content means designing and producing content that everyone can use

blocks.prompt:
56 Name two ways of gathering user feedback, with examples.
(User feedback lene ke do tareeqe misalon ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Surveys aur forms: website banane ke baad users se tajurbe par raye.
2. Direct communication: presentation par class fellows se raye.

book_ref.quote: Engage with users directly to understand their needs and preferences
